newsitem.title: USA: Biocontrol knows no reason for stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Biocontrol knows no reason for stock drop.

text.p: Biocontrol Technology Inc said Thursday that nothing material had occurred that should have caused the sudden drop in the company's stock.
"All company projects are proceeding as planned, and we will continue to update the public as events warrant," Chief Executive Fred Cooper said.
As of Thursday afternoon, the company's stock stood at 1-13/16, down 1/32.

The company said last week that its revised its 510(k) premarket notification for its Diasensor 1000, a noninvasive glucose sensor, that was submitted to the Food and Drug Administration on October 11. It has yet to receive a response to the submission.
